summary: Extend deterministic current-Email header answers to Cc, Bcc and Reply-To.
decision_refs: The active objective requires adaptable Email Q&A alongside RFI and Submittal
Existing grounding already validates Cc, Bcc and Reply-To roles
The current-header local path can reuse those fields without a parser change or model call
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested Trunk Tools-style questions answered from existing project files; this bounded change extends that existing grounded path.
known_limitations: Only strict English Cc, Bcc and Reply-To questions for the only analyzed Email or one exact named Email file use the shortcut.
Each complete printed header is one value; repeated different current headers fail closed instead of being merged.
Quoted history, body text, vision narration, missing values and more than 32 current-header passages remain excluded.
The shortcut does not expand distribution lists or infer delivery, readership, identity, thread position or authority.
